name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: A single-month date picker: the month and year sit between two chevrons above a grid of weekday headings and date numbers. Arrows move between months and a click chooses a day.
use: A form needs one date chosen from a familiar month grid with quick month-by-month browsing.
avoid: Only one month is on screen, so reaching a distant date takes repeated clicks.
a11y: Grid arrow-key movement and labelled weekdays come from the date library, but selected and today rely on colour and a tiny dot alone. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A borderless dark grid about 300 pixels wide. A centred month and year in white sits between two grey chevrons, followed by a row of two-letter weekday headings and five or six rows of light grey date numbers, with days from adjacent months dimmed.
behaves: Clicking a chevron moves the grid one month back or forward and a faint round highlight appears under the pointer. Clicking a day selects it with a filled circle, and today keeps a small dot beneath its number.
customise: Any date-picker prop can set the selection mode, chosen date, month limits and disabled days; per-part styling is overridable through the classNames map.
weight: light: One month of plain buttons rendered by the date library; no timers or loops.
